title: Kestrel Dealer Wholesale Floorplan Line Terms for Paying Off Retailed Units and Releasing Used-Unit Titles
content:
1. **Payoff deadline.** A unit must be paid off within the grade's payoff period after sale, in business days, after its retail sale or within the grade's payoff period after funding, in business days, after the retail contract funds, whichever comes first.
2. **Automatic debit.** Where the grade provides for automatic payoff debit, Kestrel debits the payoff when the retail contract funds through Kestrel.
3. **Used-unit titles.** Where the grade provides that Kestrel holds titles to used units, titles to used units are released to the dealer within the grade's title release period, in business days, after payoff.

These terms apply to every unit floored on the Kestrel Dealer Wholesale Floorplan Line once it is sold at retail. A payoff is recorded against the unit's VIN with its payoff date and amount, and it reduces the line's outstanding wholesale principal. The periods are those of the line's Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade.

## Which deadline governs

The two clocks start from different events, the retail sale and the funding of the retail contract, and the earlier of the two resulting deadlines is the one the unit must meet.

Hypothetical periods for illustration only: 4 business days after sale and 2 business days after funding.

| Hypothetical case | Deadline from the sale | Deadline from funding | Governing deadline |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sold on a business day; contract funds the next business day | 4th business day after the sale | 3rd business day after the sale | 3rd business day after the sale |
| Sold on a business day; contract funds 3 business days later | 4th business day after the sale | 5th business day after the sale | 4th business day after the sale |

## Clause 2 and clause 3 by condition

| Condition | Effect |
|---|---|
| Automatic payoff debit applies to the grade and the retail contract funds through Kestrel | Kestrel debits the payoff when that contract funds |
| Title hold on used units applies to the grade and a used unit is paid off | The title is released to the dealer within the title release period after the payoff |

Abstract boundary for the title release: with a release period of a given number of business days, a release on the last of those business days after the payoff is within the period.
